# pkguard

> Scan package-manager settings and advisories across a folder of repos. Rust binary. `pkguard scan` does not write files. Free and open source under the MIT license, maintained by Jack McNicol.

The full version of this file, with every command, flag, preset, and manager, is at https://pkguard.dev/llms-full.txt

## Install

```
brew install jackmcpickle/pkguard/pkguard
```

```
brew tap jackmcpickle/pkguard
brew trust jackmcpickle/pkguard
brew install pkguard
```

Cargo is the fallback if you already have a Rust toolchain:

```
cargo install --git https://github.com/jackmcpickle/pkguard pkguard
```

## Commands

See https://pkguard.dev/docs/commands/scan for flags from the binary (`pkguard dump-catalog`).
